Food & Perishables

Products that move fast.

Logistics for products that move fast and need availability, accuracy and continuous management of stock and distribution all the way.

Temperature-controlled transport

The fleet includes temperature-controlled trucks, vehicles approved for dangerous goods and food, and dedicated trucks and equipment for sensitive and special cargo.

Our Kiryat Ata logistics centre, with 5,500 m² of logistics space, includes an automated freezer warehouse at minus 25 degrees.

Our logisticscentres.

  1. 01Picking by different methods: FIFO, FEFO, LIFO
  2. 02Inventory managed in advanced systems, with instant access to information and stock tracking
  3. 03Voice picking (Pick by Voice)
  4. 04Integrated with Orian's distribution system
